records.jp: こ、今度は何の用？
records.en_original: Wh-what is it this time?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is it this time?
records.en: Wh-what do you need this time?

records.jp: 安心したまえ。<CR>今日は試食をしてもらうだけだ
records.en_original: Don't worry. Today, we just need you for a taste test.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. Today, we just need you for a taste test.
records.en: Rest assured.<CR>Today, you only need to taste-test something.

records.jp: やったー！<CR>なになに？　早くちょうだいよ
records.en_original: Yay! What is it? Gimme, gimme!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! What is it? Gimme, gimme!
records.en: Yay!<CR>What is it? Hurry and give it to me!

records.jp: まぁ、そう急くな。<CR>とりあえず詩帆の元へ行くがよい
records.en_original: All right, calm down. Go find Shiho for now.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, calm down. Go find Shiho for now.
records.en: Now, do not be so impatient.<CR>Go to Shiho for the moment.

records.jp: えーなんだろ。楽しみだなぁ
records.en_original: I can't wait! I wonder what we're having.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't wait! I wonder what we're having.
records.en: Ooh, what could it be? I'm looking forward to it.

records.jp: 何これ……うっふ
records.en_original: Wh-what is this...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is this...?
records.en: What is this... Ugh.

records.jp: ……くっっっさ！<CR>何入れたの！？
records.en_original: Eugh! That smells awful!! What did you put in it?!
records.en_auxiliary: Eugh! That smells awful!! What did you put in it?!
records.en: ...It stiiinks!<CR>What did you put in it!?

records.jp: 滋養がありそうな野菜全部
records.en_original: Every single vegetable that looked nutritious.
records.en_auxiliary: Every single vegetable that looked nutritious.
records.en: Every vegetable that looked nourishing.

records.jp: あと、ココロトープで拾った健康に良さそうなもの
records.en_original: Along with anything that looked healthy we picked up in Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Along with anything that looked healthy we picked up in Heartscape.
records.en: And anything we found in the Heartscape that looked healthy.

records.jp: イメージだけじゃ健康にならないんだよ！
records.en_original: Just because something "looks" healthy doesn't mean you should eat it!
records.en_auxiliary: Just because something "looks" healthy doesn't mean you should eat it!
records.en: Something doesn't become healthy just because it looks like it is!

records.jp: なんで？　どうしてこんなことになっちゃったの？<CR>詩帆さんと美弦さんがいるのに！
records.en_original: How did this happen? Didn't Shiho or Mio say anything?
records.en_auxiliary: How did this happen? Didn't Shiho or Mio say anything?
records.en: Why? How did it end up like this?<CR>Even with Shiho-san and Mio-san here!

records.jp: 詩帆が皆のために元気が出る料理を作りたいって<CR>言い出して、きららがそれに乗って
records.en_original: Shiho said she wanted to make something that would give everyone lots of energy, so Kirara got to work.
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho said she wanted to make something that would give everyone lots of energy, so Kirara got to work.
records.en: Shiho said she wanted to make food that would give everyone energy,<CR>and Kirara went along with it.

records.jp: 作っているうちにあの効能も欲しい、<CR>この効能も欲しいってどんどん出てきて
records.en_original: And then it was a lot of "a little of this" and "we need some of that", and...
records.en_auxiliary: And then it was a lot of "a little of this" and "we need some of that", and...
records.en: As they made it, they kept wanting this benefit,<CR>then that benefit, one after another...

records.jp: 私は……止めたんだけど。<CR>二人ともああ見えて頑固だから
records.en_original: I...tried to stop them, but they're more stubborn than they look.
records.en_auxiliary: I...tried to stop them, but they're more stubborn than they look.
records.en: I... tried to stop them.<CR>But both of them are more stubborn than they look.

records.jp: 詩帆ー！　唐辛子は？
records.en_original: Shiho! What about chili peppers?
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho! What about chili peppers?
records.en: Shiho! What about chili peppers?

records.jp: 新陳代謝ＵＰですね！<CR>入れちゃいましょう！
records.en_original: Good for the metabolism! Put it in!
records.en_auxiliary: Good for the metabolism! Put it in!
records.en: They boost metabolism!<CR>Let's put them in!

records.jp: あとは……にんにく！
records.en_original: And...garlic!
records.en_auxiliary: And...garlic!
records.en: And then... garlic!

records.jp: 普段なら躊躇してしまうところですが、<CR>健康には代えがたいですよね！
records.en_original: Normally I wouldn't, but there's no substitute for good health!
records.en_auxiliary: Normally I wouldn't, but there's no substitute for good health!
records.en: Normally I would hesitate, but<CR>nothing is more important than health, right?

records.jp: 美弦さんも何かあります？
records.en_original: Do you want to add anything Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you want to add anything Mio?
records.en: Mio-san, do you have anything too?

records.jp: 私？　生姜くらいしか思いつかないわ
records.en_original: Me? Ginger's the only thing that comes to mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Me? Ginger's the only thing that comes to mind.
records.en: Me? Ginger is the only thing that comes to mind.

records.jp: 生姜！　<CR>ああっ、忘れてました！
records.en_original: Ginger! I knew we forgot something!
records.en_auxiliary: Ginger! I knew we forgot something!
records.en: Ginger!<CR>Ah, I forgot about that!

records.jp: 全部いい。<CR>全部入れよう
records.en_original: All of it. Let's put it all in.
records.en_auxiliary: All of it. Let's put it all in.
records.en: They're all good.<CR>Let's put them all in.

records.jp: お願いだからせめて一つだけにして……
records.en_original: Just one is enough... Please.
records.en_auxiliary: Just one is enough... Please.
records.en: Please, at least limit it to one...

records.jp: じゃあ……
records.en_original: How about...
records.en_auxiliary: How about...
records.en: Then...

records.jp: 唐辛子がいいんじゃない？<CR>
records.en_original: Chili peppers seem good.
records.en_auxiliary: Chili peppers seem good.
records.en: How about chili peppers?<CR>

records.jp: 共に歩んでくれるか、愛央！
records.en_original: We walk the same road, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: We walk the same road, Ao!
records.en: Will you walk this path with us, Ao!

records.jp: もうここまで来たらとことん地獄を見よう。<CR>その先に光がある
records.en_original: We're standing at the gates of hell. There's no turning back. But there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
records.en_auxiliary: We're standing at the gates of hell. There's no turning back. But there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
records.en: Now that we've come this far, let's see hell through to the end.<CR>There is light beyond it.

records.jp: うん、あってほしいよ……
records.en_original: I hope so...
records.en_auxiliary: I hope so...
records.en: Yeah, I hope there is...

records.jp: にんにくにしたら？<CR>ワンチャン全部リセットできそう
records.en_original: How about garlic? It might be so strong that it'll cover up all the other flavors.
records.en_auxiliary: How about garlic? It might be so strong that it'll cover up all the other flavors.
records.en: What about garlic?<CR>Maybe it has a chance of resetting everything.

records.jp: よーし、いっぱい入れちゃいますよー！
records.en_original: I'll be sure to put in lots then!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be sure to put in lots then!
records.en: All right, I'll put in plenty!

records.jp: にんにく臭、みんなで食べれば怖くない、ですよね！
records.en_original: And we won't have to feel embarrassed about our breath smelling like garlic if we all eat it!
records.en_auxiliary: And we won't have to feel embarrassed about our breath smelling like garlic if we all eat it!
records.en: Garlic breath isn't scary if everyone eats it, right!

records.jp: （詩帆さん、大義名分を得て<CR>めっちゃ活き活きしてる……）
records.en_original: (Looks like Shiho is having fun with the challenge...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Looks like Shiho is having fun with the challenge...)
records.en: (Shiho-san got an excuse,<CR>and now she looks incredibly lively...)

records.jp: 生姜にしたら？<CR>少しは爽やかになるかも
records.en_original: Why don't we use some ginger? It might freshen it up a bit.
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we use some ginger? It might freshen it up a bit.
records.en: What about ginger?<CR>It might make it a little more refreshing.

records.jp: 私もその効果を期待してたの
records.en_original: My thoughts exactly.
records.en_auxiliary: My thoughts exactly.
records.en: I was hoping for that effect too.

records.jp: これで少しでもマシになることを願うわ
records.en_original: This ought to make it a little more palatable.
records.en_auxiliary: This ought to make it a little more palatable.
records.en: I hope this makes it even a little better.

records.jp: 大丈夫だって！<CR>自分を信じて美弦さん！
records.en_original: It'll be okay! Believe in yourself, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be okay! Believe in yourself, Mio!
records.en: It'll be fine!<CR>Believe in yourself, Mio-san!

records.jp: それでは味見、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Let's have our taste tester do the honors.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's have our taste tester do the honors.
records.en: Then, please taste it for us.

records.jp: 生きて帰ってこれますように……
records.en_original: I'll see you all on the other side...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll see you all on the other side...
records.en: Please let me come back alive...

records.jp: どうですか？
records.en_original: How is it?
records.en_auxiliary: How is it?
records.en: How is it?

records.jp: あれ、なんか視界がぼやけてきた
records.en_original: Huh? My vision is getting blurry...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? My vision is getting blurry...
records.en: Huh? My vision is starting to blur...

records.jp: 愛央、ごめんなさい！<CR>私が強く止めていれば……！
records.en_original: I'm so sorry, Ao! I should have stopped you—
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry, Ao! I should have stopped you—
records.en: Ao, I'm sorry!<CR>If only I had stopped them more forcefully...!

records.jp: いや、待て
records.en_original: No, wait.
records.en_auxiliary: No, wait.
records.en: Wait.

records.jp: ……なんか、今なら何でもできそうな気がする
records.en_original: I feel like...I can do anything.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like...I can do anything.
records.en: ...I feel like I can do anything right now.

records.jp: とりあえず学校の周り３０周してくるね
records.en_original: I'm gonna go run 30 laps around the school.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna go run 30 laps around the school.
records.en: I'm going to run thirty laps around the school for now.

records.jp: 健康になったのは身体だけみたいね……
records.en_original: Looks like whatever we made doesn't have much effect on intelligence…
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like whatever we made doesn't have much effect on intelligence…
records.en: It seems only her body got healthier...
